name: Agenda — admin configura horario semanal recurrente
description: Tras iniciar sesión como admin, el usuario abre Agenda, configura días semanales con rango e intervalo para Llevar stock, guarda la regla y ve disponibilidad generada en el calendario mensual.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the configured admin credentials if the login page is shown
Verify the Agenda page shows a weekly availability configuration card for Llevar stock with weekday buttons
Select Monday Wednesday and Saturday in the Llevar stock weekly rule
Set the shared time range from 12:00 to 14:00
Select the division option Cada 30 min
Verify the month calendar shows available-slot badges on upcoming days that match the weekly rule, laid out in a grid of weekday columns
